interface.longDescription: Chat-first amateur radio help in Greek and English: RF and antenna calculations, live space weather, satellite passes, POTA and WSPR spots, repeaters, contest calendar, and official legal texts from the Greek Government Gazette, EETT, CEPT and the US eCFR with change checks. No transmit permission, legal advice or device control.
